block.fromage.vat.tooltip: Set above a lit campfire. Milk warms by itself. Stir cultured milk once, then cut it. Sneak-use plain warm milk to make a starter.
block.fromage.draining_table.tooltip: Place a curd bundle here. Its cloth becomes the liner.
item.fromage.acid_culture.tooltip: Add to warm milk in the vat to start setting the curd.
item.fromage.curd_knife.tooltip: Cuts set curds in a vat. An empty hand works too.
item.fromage.cheesecloth.tooltip: Lift cut curds from the vat. Recover the cloth from the draining table.
item.fromage.curds.tooltip: From milk and acid culture. Drain them, then mold them into soft farmer’s cheese. The vat keeps plain whey.
item.fromage.whey.tooltip: From a plain milk-and-culture batch. It is not a starter. Pour the next milk into that whey, or bottle it to keep.
item.fromage.farmers_cheese.tooltip: Eat it soft or craft it with bread for a cheese sandwich.
item.fromage.farmers_cheese.tooltip.deli: Crumble on a Cutting Board or cook into dumplings in a Cooking Pot.
item.fromage.cooking_cheese.tooltip.cook: Cook with flour and lettuce in Kaleidoscope's Pot to make flatbread.
item.fromage.cheese_sandwich.tooltip: A filling meal made by toasting a cheese sandwich in a smoker.
item.fromage.cheese_toast.tooltip: Toast in a smoker before eating.
item.fromage.cheese_crumbles.tooltip: Cook with wheat dough and cabbage in a Cooking Pot.
item.fromage.cheese_dumplings.tooltip: A filling meal of cheese, cabbage, and wheat dough.
item.fromage.cheese_flatbread.tooltip: A filling pan-fried meal made with cheese, flour, and lettuce.
message.fromage.vat.cold: The vat is cold. Light the campfire directly below it.
message.fromage.vat.2: Add acid culture to the warm milk.
message.fromage.vat.3: Stir once with an empty hand to start the curds setting.
message.fromage.vat.stir: Stir once with an empty hand to start the curds setting.
message.fromage.vat.coagulating: The curds are setting. Let them finish before cutting.
message.fromage.vat.4: Use an empty hand to cut the curd.
message.fromage.vat.5: Lift the cut curds with cheesecloth.
message.fromage.table.1: Add the curds to the lined table.
message.fromage.table.2: Let the curds settle and drain.
message.fromage.table.3: Collect the soft blue cheese with an empty hand.
block.fromage.cheese_mold.tooltip: Shape drained curds. One tap starts a cheddar press; the plate finishes itself.
block.fromage.young_cheese_block.tooltip: Place it down to ripen for 15 seconds.
block.fromage.aged_cheese_block.tooltip: Right-click it when placed or craft it in your inventory for four wedges.
message.fromage.mold.0: Load two portions of salted cheddar curds.
message.fromage.mold.2: The cheese is ripening inside the mold.
item.fromage.packed_cheese_mold.tooltip: Place it down to ripen the farmer’s cheese inside.
item.fromage.packed_blue_cheese_mold.too: Place it down to ripen the blue cheese inside.
item.fromage.blue_starter.tooltip: Add to warm milk to start a blue cheese batch.
item.fromage.blue_curds.tooltip: Unfold on the draining table. Mold the drained bundle into a young wheel.
item.fromage.fresh_blue_cheese.tooltip: Eat it soft. Mold drained blue curds, not this cheese, to start a wheel.
block.fromage.aged_blue_cheese_block.too: Right-click it when placed or craft it in your inventory for four wedges.
message.fromage.table.4: Collect the whey with a glass bottle.
message.fromage.mold.ready: Collect the aged cheese block with an empty hand.
message.fromage.mold.mixed: This mold already contains a different cheese.
message.fromage.mold.packing: Hold use to pack the mold.
block.fromage.firebox_vat.tooltip: Fuel the hearth with coal. Milk warms by itself. Stir cultured milk once, then cut it.
message.fromage.firebox.empty: The firebox is empty. Add coal or charcoal.
message.fromage.firebox.lit: Firebox burning. %s seconds of fuel left.
message.fromage.firebox.banked: Fire banked. Relight with flint and steel. %s seconds of fuel left.
item.fromage.mild_cheese_wedge.tooltip: A bite-sized slice of mild cheese.
item.fromage.blue_cheese_wedge.tooltip: A bite-sized slice of blue cheese.
message.fromage.table.soft: Collect the soft farmer’s cheese and whey with an empty hand.
message.fromage.mold.soft: Farmer’s cheese is ready to eat.
message.fromage.mold.blue_fresh: Soft blue cheese is ready to eat. Mold the drained curds instead.
item.fromage.vat_starter.tooltip: Add to warm milk to start a batch that produces cultured whey. Returns the bottle.
item.fromage.cultured_whey.tooltip: From blue, cheddar, or a starter batch. Add it to warm milk to culture the next batch. Returns the bottle.
item.fromage.cultured_curds.tooltip: From a starter or cultured whey. They become the same soft farmer’s cheese. The vat keeps cultured whey for the next batch.
item.fromage.vegetable_rennet.tooltip: Add any time after the milk is warm and before the curds are cut, even before the culture.
item.fromage.cheddar_curds.tooltip: Unfold on the draining table. Turn the knitted curds before adding salt.
item.fromage.salt.tooltip: Use on a turned cheddar slab on the draining table.
item.fromage.salted_cheddar_curds.toolti: Load two portions into a placed mold. One tap starts the press.
item.fromage.packed_cheddar_mold.tooltip: Place this older mold to press its curds directly.
block.fromage.cheese_press.tooltip: Processes packed cheddar molds from older workshops.
item.fromage.pressed_cheddar.tooltip: Set on an aging shelf. Turn it to age it a little faster. Lifting it keeps that wait.
block.fromage.aging_shelf.tooltip: Ages two cheeses. Turn a young wheel to speed it up. Sneak-lift keeps its progress and its turn wait.
block.fromage.aged_cheddar_block.tooltip: Slice four wedges by right-clicking the placed cheese or crafting the whole block.
item.fromage.cheddar_wedge.tooltip: Eat it or use it in compatible cooking recipes.
message.fromage.vat.7: Collect the starter culture with a glass bottle.
message.fromage.table.cheddar.0: Turn the knitted cheddar slab with an empty hand.
message.fromage.mold.cheddar_ready: Pick up the packed mold with an empty hand.
message.fromage.mold.press_next: Load the packed cheddar mold into a press.
message.fromage.press.1: Turn the press handle with an empty hand.
message.fromage.press.5: Collect the pressed cheddar and empty mold.
message.fromage.shelf.empty: Place a young cheese in this slot.
message.fromage.vat.start_fermentation: Use with empty hands to start fermenting the milk.
message.fromage.vat.add_rennet: Add the vegetable rennet for cheddar.
message.fromage.vat.culture_after_rennet: Rennet is in. Add culture, then stir once.
message.fromage.vat.rennet_or_cut: Cut the curds, or add rennet first if this should be cheddar.
message.fromage.vat.rennet_not_now: Add rennet after the milk is warm and before the curds are cut.
message.fromage.vat.rennet_already: Rennet is already in this batch.
message.fromage.vat.rennet_ferment: Rennet is in this milk. Add culture instead of fermenting it.
message.fromage.vat.blue_after_rennet: Rennet is already in. Blue starter would be wasted.
message.fromage.firebox.add_fuel: Add coal to light the firebox.
message.fromage.firebox.relight: Use flint and steel to relight banked fuel.
message.fromage.mold.add_blue: Add a portion of soft blue cheese.
message.fromage.mold.more_blue: Add one more portion of soft blue cheese.
message.fromage.mold.more_cheddar: Add one more portion of salted cheddar curds.
message.fromage.shelf.aging: Leave the cheddar on the shelf to age.
message.fromage.shelf.ready: Mature. Use an empty hand to collect it.
message.fromage.cheese.slice: Use an empty hand to slice one wedge.
message.fromage.vat.8: Pour in the next milk, or bottle this whey.
message.fromage.vat.pour_next: Pour in the next milk, or bottle this whey.
message.fromage.vat.collect_cultured_whe: Use a glass bottle to collect cultured whey.
message.fromage.vat.milk_after_cultured: Bottle this cultured whey before pouring more milk.
message.fromage.table.collect_soft: Collect the soft cheese with an empty hand.
item.fromage.cheese_grater.tooltip: Hold a cheddar wedge in your offhand. Hold use on placed pasta or cake to grate it.
item.fromage.grated_cheddar.tooltip: Tops pasta and cake. Use in cheddar pasta or cheddar potato recipes.
item.fromage.cheddar_potato.tooltip: A baked potato finished with a portion of grated cheddar.
block.fromage.pasta_bowl.tooltip: Place the bowl to eat it. It can be topped with grated cheddar.
block.fromage.cheddar_pasta.tooltip: Place and eat to become Pungent for 20 seconds. Returns the bowl.
message.fromage.grater.use: Hold use to grate cheddar over the meal.
message.fromage.grater.wedge: Hold a cheddar wedge in your offhand.
message.fromage.meal.top: Add the grated cheddar to this meal.
message.fromage.meal.eat: Use an empty hand to eat the pasta.
item.fromage.drained_farmer_curds.toolti: Pack into a placed mold to make soft farmer’s cheese.
item.fromage.drained_blue_curds.tooltip: Pack into a placed mold to make young blue cheese.
block.fromage.pressed_cheddar.tooltip: Set on an aging shelf. Turn it to age it a little faster. Lifting it keeps that wait.
block.fromage.young_blue_cheese.tooltip: Place on the aging rack and turn it to develop its veins. Lifting it keeps that wait.
block.fromage.extra_aged_cheddar_block.t: A deep-rinded cheddar. Use the placed block to cut four wedges.
block.fromage.extra_aged_blue_cheese_blo: Blue cheese with deeper veins. Use the placed block to cut four wedges.
message.fromage.table.bundle_ready: Lift the drained curds and recover the cloth.
message.fromage.mold.pack_soft: Pack the drained farmer’s curds here.
message.fromage.mold.pack_blue: Pack the drained blue curds here.
message.fromage.mold.start_press: Use an empty hand to start the press.
message.fromage.mold.watch_plate: The plate is pressing. It finishes on its own.
message.fromage.mold.press_now: The plate finishes on its own.
message.fromage.mold.pressing: The plate is pressing. It finishes on its own.
message.fromage.mold.lift_cheddar: Lift the young cheddar with an empty hand.
message.fromage.mold.blue_draining: Let the blue curds drain in the mold.
message.fromage.wheel.pick_up: Use an empty hand to lift the wheel.
message.fromage.shelf.fresh: Fresh cheese. Use an empty hand to turn it.
message.fromage.shelf.rind: Rind developing. Use an empty hand to turn it.
message.fromage.shelf.extra: Extra-aged. Use an empty hand to collect it.
